codes.title: Code lists
codes.subtitle: The drop-down and status lists this project picks from. Rename a value in your own words, add your own, or hide a company value you don't use. Records that already hold a value keep it.
codes.companySubtitle: The FTC-wide library every project starts from. A project can rename, add or hide values for itself.
codes.pinnedHint: The application relies on this value: it can be renamed, never retired or hidden.
codes.system: This list is fixed: the application depends on every value in it.
codes.companyOnly: This list is kept company-wide; projects cannot change it.
codes.readOnly: Only this project's admins can change its lists.
codes.renameHint: Every record in this project holding {code} shows the new wording, including the next baseline. Earlier baselines keep the wording they froze.
codes.useCompanyBody: {code} goes back to the company wording "{label}" in this project, on every record that holds it.
codes.retireBody: {code} leaves the pickers. Records that already hold it keep it.
codes.label: Wording
codes.codeHelp: Capital letters, digits and _, starting with a letter. It never changes once saved.
